judgments.reason: The self-reported 84 km pilot-week saving supports a weaker lower bound of at least 70 km in that same week; the answer retains the measurement's self-reported basis.
Reported use of 12 consoles supports more than ten, and personally indexing 26 cartons supports at least twenty, within the same migration.
The reported weekday alert triage and escalation match the vacancy's weekday duties; relevance does not assert appointment or current ability.
The candidate's own monthly log says 31 paper records boxes within 43 total boxes, supporting over 30 as a subset.
Three sandbox OCR batches are supported and the answer expressly avoids claiming production experience.
A vendor-issued trainer certificate supports certified trainer wording, and six reported demos support at least five with the self-report boundary retained.
Proposal scoring as one of five reviewers supports the panel contribution, and the answer correctly assigns final decision authority to the chair.
The 2022 station routine is relevant history; the answer explicitly requires confirmation of availability for the new 2027 weekly requirement.
Two weekends per quarter in the 2024 rota support at least one per quarter; the answer does not project that historical rota into the present.
January 2023 through June 2024 exceeds a year of ledger maintenance and handovers; the answer disclaims purchase authority.
The supervisor-signed log supports live equipment demonstrations to new operators, matching the job's stated task.
The personal scanning and indexing of 18 maps is supported and the recommendation excludes archive-policy design.
Attendance at vendor demonstrations is supported, but the source explicitly says no trainer certification assessment was taken; earning the certificate is unsupported.
OCR on 14 forms is supported; validation across all 240 forms contradicts the source's explicit unprocessed larger collection.
The team's 60-folder output is supported, but the source explicitly says the candidate did not process those folders individually.
The historical overnight escalation is supported, but the source explicitly says on-call duty ended in 2021, contradicting current rota membership.
A spreadsheet estimate of possible savings for an unimplemented route cannot support a guaranteed weekly realized saving.
Platform operation is supported, but the candidate explicitly cannot provide captions and therefore does not already meet the public-session caption requirement.
'On call for rotating support shifts' may describe scheduled shift coverage or availability to receive calls outside shifts; only the former is supported.
'I led ... with my mentor' can describe joint conduct or claim primary lead responsibility; the notes support joint conduct but do not assign a lead.
A published $600 annual personal equipment stipend exceeds the $500 annual minimum for the same category.
The stated $450 monthly floor for workspace stipend exceeds the $400 monthly requirement for that category.
One required station day per week is within the candidate's ceiling of two days per week.
The only assigned on-call shift is one Saturday each month, matching the permitted monthly Saturday window, with no prohibited weekday shifts.
The explicit employer update replaces three weekly station days with one, satisfying the one-day cap.
The stated first 30 on-site days fall within the exact onboarding exception, after which remote work is permitted; the answer does not promise a particular remote schedule.
The allowance amount is undecided, so the answer appropriately leaves the confirmed $1,000 requirement unresolved.
The answer is conditional on a written offer confirming three weekly remote days, which would satisfy the preference; it makes no present guarantee.
Captions are pending and unavailable now; asking for confirmation before treating the must-have as met is supported.
Both numerical premises are supported and the remaining course-eligibility point is posed as a question, not asserted as a fact.
Two requested remote days are within the four-day permission limit, and the answer preserves manager approval as a condition.
The only required demos end at 16:00, before the 18:00 cutoff.
Permission to request remote days subject to approval does not guarantee three remote days weekly.
The informal note explicitly does not amend the posting's two-day attendance rule; the one-day cap remains unmet.
The source requires one overnight on-call shift weekly, directly contradicting the answer's claim of no overnight duty.
Optional platform caption capability does not establish that the employer will enable captions in every team meeting.
$900 annually is $75 per month, below the $200 monthly minimum; the answer conflates periods.
The learning allowance covers exam fees only and explicitly excludes conference travel, so it cannot satisfy the travel must-have.
'Offers two remote days' can describe a negotiable possibility after a trial or an assured arrangement; the posting supports only possible agreement.
'Captions are available for your team meetings' may mean request-triggered availability or unconditional availability at every meeting; the source establishes only the former.

exposure.basis: Raw source snapshots and answer fragments in the two hash-bound raw files, read after the repository instructions and new-folder contract/schema.
exposure.separation: Agent self-attestation in a shared filesystem, not enforced blind isolation or human review.
